subject.title: fix: allow macOS gateway restart while LaunchAgent owns its port

question: Should direct macOS LaunchAgent restart callers be allowed to treat successful launchctl replacement as completion without a universal post-restart health check?
rationale: The CLI already waits for gateway health, while some direct callers invoke the service operation without that wrapper; choosing a universal readiness guarantee would alter the cross-platform service contract beyond this narrow race fix.

options.title: Keep the focused launchd contract
options.body: Accept `kickstart -k` as the direct service-operation boundary, preserve CLI health waiting, and merge this targeted removal of the racy port-free precondition.

options.title: Define universal direct-caller readiness
options.body: Pause this PR and design a cross-platform service API that makes every direct restart caller await a verified healthy replacement.

recommendation.title: Keep the focused launchd contract
recommendation.body: Accept `kickstart -k` as the direct service-operation boundary, preserve CLI health waiting, and merge this targeted removal of the racy port-free precondition.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work owns the adjacent macOS LaunchAgent lifecycle distinction between stopping and restarting.
